name: DC-DC step-down (buck) converters
summary: Small switching boards that drop a DC voltage efficiently: 24V to 12V, 12V to 5V.
uses: Matching a device to a different battery voltage
identify: Small boards with a coil, a chip and capacitors, often with a brass trimmer. Inside car USB chargers, routers, TVs, printers and e-bike displays; modules are marked LM2596, MP1584 or XL4015.
test: Feed 12V in and measure the output: it should match the setting and stay steady under load. A chip that runs hot with no load is failing.
